materials.surfacePolicy: Simplified matte albedo fields. Recesses and trim are selective geometry; no photo textures, brick grain, asphalt noise, pores or procedural dirt.
materials.glass: Restrained dark panes with broad reflections; no mirrored photographic panorama.
materials.foliage: Irregular organic lobed crowns, selective silhouette detail; no repeated spherical clusters, no dense leaf microgeometry.
materials.detailLevel: Real proportions and silhouette; selective structural detail, simplified surface information.

peopleVehicles.policy: Near-photoreal generic form under the same matte lighting, no brands, detailed faces, readable signage or insignia.

distanceBands.people: Real anatomy, gait, clothing folds at broad scale; non-identifying facial planes, no detailed features.
distanceBands.vehicles: Real class proportions, wheels, broad glass and panel forms; no badge, identifying grille or plate text.

distanceBands.people: Natural pose and clothing colour groups; facial detail removed.
distanceBands.vehicles: Silhouette, wheel placement, glass groups; merge small trim.

distanceBands.people: Natural uninflated silhouette and muted colour groups.
distanceBands.vehicles: Real class silhouette, subdued broad glazing, no trim.

distanceBands.policy: Cull ambient actors below visibility threshold; never inflate actors.

peopleVehicles.selection: Projected size determines detail; metre bands are illustrative and depend on FOV, viewport and camera.

modeArchitecture.easy: Eight guided steps, phone and desktop
modeArchitecture.sharedModel: A single plan, common part ids and units; mode is only presentation
modeArchitecture.guest: Read-only version snapshot, never the working editor

creator_kit.serviceEnvelope: width + 2 * margin; depth + 2 * margin; illustrative editable supplier allowance
creator_kit.forecasts: Example data only. Future event dates use scenarios until forecast horizon is available. Forecast UI must distinguish issue time, valid time, location and uncertainty.
creator_kit.placeRegistration: Upload -> detect anchors -> manual confirm three points and known distance -> accept. No guessed map alignment automatically accepted. Base map stays locked.
creator_kit.share: Create immutable layout snapshot; changes require new shared version. Event time versus now are distinct.
creator_kit.export: Pro shows JSON, parts list, version snapshots. Production scoped PDF/CAD/georeferenced exports represented only.
creator_kit.eventTimezone: Derived from the real location and stored on the plan; all event-time sun/forecast views use it.

detail_tiers.parts: Frame/poles, major openings, generic switches, door/queue-clearance cues
Silhouette + broad material groups, openings and service-zone outline
Simple massing/palette; abstract crowd density overlays in Pro only
Cull decorative detail; retain route/zone overlays at usable UI thickness

performance: Design targets only, not profiled: merged/instanced tent frames and chairs; crowd proxies at distance; no per-part dynamic lights; route overlays separate from ground; default participant illustration is not crowd simulation.
